instruction: Create a PDF version of the OIP.jpg receipt image from /home/user. Store the resulting PDF file as "receipt_scan.pdf" in the Downloads directory.

metadata.explanation: Task converts OIP.jpg to PDF as 'receipt_scan.pdf' in Downloads folder. Evaluator verifies file exists at /home/user/Downloads/receipt_scan.pdf with 1 page and valid image content.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all requirements (file location, PDF format, page count, content validity)
Correct page count verification: Checks for exactly 1 page (eq relation with ref_value=1) which matches single image conversion
Semantic content verification: verify_content flag enables checking for embedded images, ensuring actual image-to-PDF conversion occurred
Robust validation: File existence check, file size check (>10KB), and image presence check prevent false positives from empty/invalid PDFs
Correct getter usage: get_vm_file properly retrieves PDF from VM filesystem at specified path
Proper postconfig: 2-second sleep allows filesystem sync before verification
